CPU reset vector → real HR-16 v1.09 firmware
Firmware owns the machine: keypad scanning, LCD writes, LEDs, NVRAM access and 5-byte DM3AG commands all come from the original OS. Sound starts only when the firmware writes a real DM3AG command. U16/U15 are the original supplied HR-16 sound EPROMs (8e103536 / 82e9b78c). Volume/pan/tune bits that remain undocumented are shown raw instead of being invented.
Enhanced sequencer routes every step through the emulated HR-16 key matrix → firmware → DM3AG.

Native HR-16 PATT 00 may be empty, so pressing the hardware PLAY key can legitimately produce silence. Pattern Studio is separate from the HR-16's stored NVRAM patterns but fires the real firmware pads, so its loaded patterns make the original OS generate the DM3AG sound commands.
